name: Into the Mists
description: Help Barovia face the danger at its church, then escort Ireena along the old road to Madam Eva at Tser Pool.

prologue.text: The road behind you has become a wall of mist. A few lamps still burn in Barovia. Find Ismark in the village before you venture farther.

stages.name: Subdue Doru
stages.description: Subdue Doru in the Village Church.

stages.name: Decide Doru's fate
stages.description: Speak to Doru; decide his fate.

stages.name: Escort Ireena
stages.description: Ask Ireena in Barovia to travel.

stages.name: Clear the old road
stages.description: Defeat the pack on Old Svalich Road.

stages.name: Hear Madam Eva
stages.description: Speak to Madam Eva at Tser Pool.
